To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the Indonesian Islamic scholars, who are members of the Islamic fatwa organizations, respond to contemporary issues.
the method used in the formulation of Islamic law in Indonesia is based on the Qur'an, Hadith, Ijma' and Qiyas.

(1) the method of fatwa is not only the result of an individual effort but also a product of a group effort, (2) fatwa is the result of a process that is not only based on the Qur'an and Sunnah but also based on the fatwa of the predecessors, (3) the method of determining Islamic law in the four organizations is different, and (4) the fatwa of each organization is different.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the method of fatwa issued by Indonesian Islamic organizations.
the methodology of the fatwa issued by Indonesian Islamic institutions.
the comparison of method of fatwa determination by Islamic organizations in Indonesia.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the methodology of the fatwa of Islamic organizations in Indonesia are different from each other.
the fatwa-making method of the Indonesian Islamic scholars is not only based on classical fiqh books but also on other sources such as the Qur’an, Sunnah, and the opinion of the scholars.
the method of the Islamic law in the four institutions is not the same.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the methodologicalapproaches of Indonesian Ulama in determining Islamic law in the four fatwaorganizations are different, but they are not in conflict.
the method of fatwa in Indonesia has been influenced by several factors, including the method of fatwas issued by the ulama of the classical Islamic world and the method of fatwā in Indonesia itself.
the Indonesian Ulama, who is organized into fatwa institutions, have a positive attitude to the development of contemporary issues.
The main takeaway from our work is that

the method of fatwa determination in Indonesia, in the four organizations, has a strong tendency toward the use of ijtihad, and the fatwa determination is done by using a combination of the method of the classical fiqh and the method of ijtihad.
the Indonesian ulama are aware of the challenges posed by contemporary issues.
there is no single methodology in Islamic jurisprudence.
